Death Stranding promoted from donor mention to explicit bounded transfer
BODY / FIT views are addressable as #loadout / #sense / #fuse / #patina / #plain without a second store
BODY / FIT manifest owns native LOADOUT / PATINA / SENSE targeted exit paths and owner identity
FIELD derives those actions through its existing manifest-owned host-action law; FIELD index code gains no per-host table

nonclaims: No claim that the six mechanics form a universal game theory.
No quest log, XP, reputation score, game economy or copied game visual skin.
No claim that BODY / FIT preparation proves physical safety, medical meaning or improved outcomes.
retirement: Remove any donor projection that adds translation/clutter without preserving a distinct useful invariant. BODY/FIT state survives removal of FIELD/manifest shortcuts.
